annotations.title: Get a Spanish company by tax ID

description: Returns the basic public record of ONE Spanish company from its tax ID (CIF/NIF): legal name, status (active, dissolved, extinguished, in insolvency...), legal form with ISO 20275 code, LEI code, activity code (CNAE), province and incorporation date, plus tax_id_revocation if the Tax Agency has revoked or reinstated its tax ID. The status is derived from Mercantile Registry gazette (BORME) filings; it is not an official certificate. The street address and the directors are not included.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834. Spaces and hyphens are accepted.
